name: Indosat 2014 MOAS hijack
notes: AS4761 (PT Indosat) briefly re-announced hundreds of thousands of prefixes globally around 18:25 UTC on 2014-04-02. The RRC00 cut fetched on 2026-05-24 with filter='path "_4761$"' over the 18:20-18:40 UTC window contains 51,203 records covering 3,728 distinct AS4761-origin prefixes; 3,674 of those are outside AS4761's normal 114.4.0.0/15 allocation and represent the hijack proper. The hand-curated baseline (data/baselines/indosat_2014_baseline.duckdb, seeded by scripts/seed_indosat_baseline.py) carries five AS45305/AS45454/AS45348-owned supernets verified against the RRC00 RIB at 2014-04-02T16:00:00Z. SubPrefixHijackDetector fires 19 alerts: 3 exact-prefix (the three /22s Indosat re-announced at the same length AS45305 owns -- 103.28.112.0/22, 124.40.248.0/21, 202.56.164.0/22) plus 16 sub-prefix more-specifics. Both detector shapes exercised, both correct. victim_asn=45305 picks the largest single victim; the broader set spans 45454, 45348, and others. To reproduce data/indosat_2014.duckdb: `uv run netpulse ingest bgp --start 2014-04-02T18:20:00 --duration 20m --collector rrc00 --filter 'path "_4761$"' --out data/indosat_2014.duckdb`. To reproduce the baseline: `uv run python scripts/seed_indosat_baseline.py data/baselines/indosat_2014_baseline.duckdb`.
